mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cold_chain_ai_tool_execution ( tool_execution_id, request_id, agent_code, tool_name, current_user_id, current_tenant_id, input_summary, execution_status, start_time ) VALUES ( #{toolExecutionId}, #{requestId}, #{agentCode}, #{toolName}, #{currentUserId}, #{currentTenantId}, #{inputSummary}, #{executionStatus}, #{startTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE cold_chain_ai_tool_execution SET execution_status = #{executionStatus}, output_summary = #{outputSummary}, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, finish_time = #{finishTime}, cost_millis = #{costMillis}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tool_execution_id = #{toolExecutionId} AND execution_status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE cold_chain_ai_tool_execution SET execution_status = #{executionStatus}, output_summary = NULL, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finish_time = #{finishTime}, cost_millis = #{costMillis}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tool_execution_id = #{toolExecutionId} AND execution_status = #{expectedStatus}
